Hero_Desc_Vela: The Ghost of Existence, born when the witches' theories became manifest. Her very existence can exert tremendous influence upon many residents of Elias. She is deeply curious about every being, including herself, and delights in learning new things.
Album_Wish_Vela: To learn about and understand every being
Album_Vela1: Vela is a ghost born in the Witch Kingdom's library. She is normally bright and energetic, but often reacts with extreme sensitivity to matters concerning her own existence.
Album_Vela2: Vela's goal is to see, hear, and learn about every being in the world. In practice, anyone conversing or traveling with her is quickly exhausted by the endless barrage of questions.
Album_Vela3: Vela enjoys new and mysterious beings, but tends to dislike anything boring and predictable. When nothing new happens and boredom sets in, she sometimes roams in search of novelty herself. Each time, I cannot stop worrying that some accident may occur.
Album_Vela4: As the Ghost of Existence, Vela is mischievous like other ghosts and enjoys speaking with the residents. Of course, the greatest reason she behaves this way is to advertise her existence and assert her presence to others.
Album_Vela5: Wishing to know every being in Elias, Vela wanders everywhere whenever she has time. The problem is that she visits without hesitation even those places whose residents still fear or distrust her... Will she be all right?
Album_Vela6: When Vela sees timid residents with no self-esteem, she complains that they are boring and asks whether living without affection for one's own existence is not tedious. Yet some recover their confidence after hearing her words. Wait, is that a good deed?
Album_Vela7: Watching Vela float and undulate sometimes makes me dizzy. Whenever I turn my gaze elsewhere, she complains that I am not concentrating on her existence. It is truly a headache.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Hate1: She likes its shape, but apparently finds the flavor far too ordinary. She says it has scarcely more presence than a knot twisted from rope.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Hate2: One look at its appearance made her push it far aside. Apparently, its form inspired no interest whatsoever.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like1: She liked its somehow familiar fragrance. Could it have reminded her of being Speaki's pumpkin companion?
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like2: Vela loved the Ghost Pudding the moment she saw its amusing shape. She liked how it could sway in every direction and return, just as her own existence does.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like3: The rice cakes in the soup seemed extraordinarily novel to Vela. After staring for a long time, she tried to grab and stretch one with her hands, so I had to stop her.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like4: The uniquely shaped buche de Noel naturally monopolized Vela's attention. Seeing her so satisfied made the preparation worthwhile.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like5: One bite made her eyes shine as she marveled that a flavor could possess such powerful presence. Apparently, the existence of tartness inside her mouth was tremendously amusing.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like6: The appearance of the songpyeon stimulated Vela's curiosity. She was especially fascinated by their different colors, though disappointed that their flavors differed so little.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like7: She seemed to enjoy the sweet yet slightly bitter flavor. She emptied the plate quickly and asked whether there was more.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like8: Fascinated by its powdery appearance, she brought her face close and stared for quite some time. When she prepared to blow upon it, I quickly placed it in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Vela_Like9: The Ball Candies, full of diverse flavors and shapes, seem to have delighted her completely. She marveled that one jar could contain so many distinct presences.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Vela: Make my existence burn even brighter.
Vela_Spawn2: I will not forgive anyone who threatens my existence.
Vela_Growth1: You will pay more attention to me now, right?
Vela_Growth2: The thrill of feeling my presence grow never gets old.
Vela_Victory1: What a delightful experience. Always fresh and entertaining!
Vela_Victory2: Is that all? Is there no more interesting existence here?
Vela_Defeat1: My existence was overwhelmed... That cannot be true.
Vela_Defeat2: It is still not enough. Everyone's presence...
Vela_Affinity1_1: Hello? Hehe, what an interesting presence.
Vela_Affinity1_2: Do not threaten my existence. Consider yourself warned.
Vela_Affinity2: The world is full of wondrous things. I want to see and hear even more.
Vela_Affinity1_3: One's existence is everything one has.
Vela_Affinity3: Well, what do you think? Do I stand out a little?
Vela_Affinity4: Do you not have a more interesting story? It is boring inside the lamp.
Vela_Affinity5: Even if I seem to flicker like candlelight, my existence will never waver.
Vela_Affinity6: Would you like to take a walk together? Let us go a little farther today.
Vela_Affinity7: I like those whose presence is unmistakable. Yes, someone like you.
Vela_Die1: I... do not want to be forgotten...!
Vela_Die2: Even so, my flame will keep burning...
Vela_LevelUp: What do you think? Hehe, do I stand out a little more now?
Vela_Equipment: Wow, I have never seen these before. I love them!
Vela_HeroSkill: Good. I will be able to burn even brighter.
Vela_HeroUpgrade: My existence has taken on another new meaning.
Vela_DeckSetting1: Let us make our existence shine even brighter.
Vela_DeckSetting2: Will I learn something new again? How exciting.
Vela_Touch1: Ugh, pulling me like that will not shake my existence.
Vela_Touch1_1: Ow. Could you be a little gentler?
Vela_Touch2_1: Ahaha. Is your hand not hot?
Vela_Touch1_2: If this will at least engrave my presence upon you...
Vela_Touch2: Hehe. This feels better than I expected.
Vela_Touch2_2: I feel my existence... gradually becoming clearer.
Vela_DutchRubEnd2: What? Did I do something wrong?

Vela_Growth2_Skin1: I like the feeling of becoming a new existence.
Vela_LevelUp_Skin1: Will these ears not grow any longer?
Vela_Equipment_Skin1: Is there anything you would like to drink?
Vela_HeroSkill_Skin1: The feeling of growing stronger is always new.
Vela_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Hop, hop! My presence is growing!
Vela_Board_Skin1: Shall we see how much farther I can jump?
Vela_Touch1_Skin1: Ugh, be gentler with this bunny's existence.
Vela_Touch1_1_Skin1: Hmph. You have no manners when dealing with an existence.
Vela_Touch1_2_Skin1: Keep doing that and I might tamper with your drink, you know?
Vela_Touch2_Skin1: Hehe, be careful not to knock off my headband.
Vela_Touch2_1_Skin1: Would you like to order? I will serve you right away.
Vela_Touch2_2_Skin1: Yes, right there. You have talent.
Vela_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ugh! Is that how you treat someone as adorable as me?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Vela_Skin2: Vela enjoyed a movie at the Sprite Kingdom theater and decided to imitate it. Her recreation is fantastic, but being struck by that tail would hurt terribly... would it not?
Vela_Growth1_Skin2: My heart races as though I were swimming through the water.
Vela_Growth2_Skin2: I can become an even more dazzling version of myself.
Vela_LevelUp_Skin2: What do you think? Do I not sparkle more than before?
Vela_HeroSkill_Skin2: I am growing with the waves.
Vela_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Let us cleave through the waves together.
Vela_Board_Skin2: Whichever way we go, the scenery is new.
Vela_Touch1_Skin2: Ugh, are you asking to be drenched?
Vela_Touch1_1_Skin2: I went to all this trouble to look radiant. Pull gently.
Vela_Touch1_2_Skin2: Hmph. I suppose I am not slippery at all?
Vela_Touch2_Skin2: Hehe. What do you think? Soft, is it not?
Vela_Touch2_1_Skin2: Your touch is like a gentle wave.
Vela_Touch2_2_Skin2: You are letting my existence... shine brighter.
Vela_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Ouch. I spent a long time doing my hair, and you're going to ruin it!
Vela_DutchRubEnd1_Skin2: Ouch. I spent a long time doing my hair, and you're going to ruin it!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Vela_Skin3: Vela has transformed into an alluring nine-tailed fox. She swishes her tails and tickles until someone tells her an interesting story.
Vela_Growth1_Skin3: I shall captivate everyone with my very existence.
Vela_Growth2_Skin3: Tell me an entertaining story and I shall let you go peacefully.
Vela_LevelUp_Skin3: I suppose I am becoming more proficient.
Vela_Equipment_Skin3: Anything looks beautiful when I wear it.
Vela_HeroSkill_Skin3: I hope everyone is not losing their heads over me.
Vela_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: I will make everyone desire my existence.
Vela_Board_Skin3: Master, what are you doing? Hurry and follow me.
Vela_Touch1_Skin3: Hah...! Watch yourself on dark roads.
Vela_Touch1_1_Skin3: Ugh... You are ruining the great nine-tailed fox's dignity!
Vela_Touch1_2_Skin3: You simply do not know what to do with yourself because I am so beautiful, right?
Vela_Touch2_Skin3: Your touch is as soft as my tails. I like it.
Vela_Touch2_1_Skin3: Could you pet my ears too?
Vela_Touch2_2_Skin3: Do not stop. Keep petting me just like that.
Vela_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: You...! I will eat your liver and suck out your marrow!
Vela_AsideGet: This is my wish? How fascinating...! I have never experienced anything like this!
Vela_AsideUpgrade: It will keep burning and burning, with no fear of fading away. Together with me...
Vela_Birthday: The birth of an existence is worth celebrating. Happy birthday, Master.
Vela_Gacha2: Make my existence burn even brighter.
Vela_Line2: My presence is still not strong enough... A little more...
Vela_Line3: The world is still full of fascinating beings.
Vela_Lobby: There are so many fascinating things here too.
LoveLetter_Vela:
Hello, Master! This is a letter from the great being herself.

A considerable time has already passed since I was born and began traveling this world. I have heard many interesting stories and met many new people. At this rate, perhaps I will return to the magnificent being I once was in no time. Watch and see how far this great being grows!

Thanks to you, not one of my days is boring, so I should repay you someday. I will use my power to transform the lonely, cold Order into somewhere splendid and spectacular. I will fill it entirely with my presence. Look forward to it! Ohoho!
LoveCall_Vela:
Hello, Master! Can you hear me?
Hehe, well? Can you feel my presence clearly even through the phone today?
Hmm? What is that? Did my allowance run out? Do I need credit for the Monatium internet cafe?
Hey, that is not it! This time I called simply because I wanted to feel your existence!
I have to confirm your presence like this from time to time, or I might become bored.

Are you not bored whenever I am away?
You should be more grateful to this great being who constantly supplies such entertaining presence beside you.
Hmm? Do you understand, Master? So raise my allowance.
What? Did I not just say that my allowance had not run out?
Argh, does that matter right now? Master! Pay a little more attention to your precious being, will you?
Huh? You are hanging up? Wait! Master? Heeey!
Affinity_Vela_EP01_001: What is existence? What is birth?
Affinity_Vela_EP01_003: Can questions be good or bad? Hmm~ Is a question not simply a question?
Affinity_Vela_EP01_004: Difficult... Those truly are difficult questions.
Affinity_Vela_EP01_005: Right. I think they are terribly difficult. Ahh~ What in the world is my existence~?
Affinity_Vela_EP01_006: Enough nonsense. What are you eating?
Affinity_Vela_EP01_007: Tch. You say that because you do not know, right? Because you have never thought about it?
Affinity_Vela_EP02_001: Hehe~ I have been watching you from here all this time, Master. You are surprisingly diligent.
Affinity_Vela_EP02_002: Clean up the wax you dripped.
Affinity_Vela_EP02_003: When did I ever drip wax?!
Affinity_Vela_EP02_005: Hee hee~ That is a secret~ I will not tell you~
Affinity_Vela_EP02_007: Wh-what? H-how did you know? Huh? Was I obvious? Was I?!
Affinity_Vela_EP03_001: How long have you known that Forsythia?
Affinity_Vela_EP03_003: Hmph, how dull. Could you give me a more entertaining answer?
Affinity_Vela_EP03_004: Longer than I have known you.
Affinity_Vela_EP03_005: Hmph. That much is obvious. So when did you meet? Why can you not answer? Did you forget?
Affinity_Vela_EP03_007: Yes. I wonder why only you could see her, and why I can see her too~ I am too curious to bear it~
Affinity_Vela_EP04_001: Sometimes I have difficulty distinguishing lumps of rock from Dragonkin.
Affinity_Vela_EP04_002: Look at them only in passing.
Affinity_Vela_EP04_003: What sort of answer is that? Could you put in a little effort? Now, if I glance casually at that Dragonkin over there... I can tell? Huh?
Affinity_Vela_EP04_005: Right? Distinguishing individuals is easy, but telling them apart from actual rocks is difficult~
Affinity_Vela_EP04_007: Hah, what do you take me for? It is because I see existence itself!
Affinity_Vela_EP05_001: I like it here because there are so many interesting people.
Affinity_Vela_EP05_002: You came here as a candle yesterday too.
Affinity_Vela_EP05_003: Wh-wh-what? N-no! That candle was not me!
Affinity_Vela_EP05_005: Uh... I-I may? I do not need to hide while I watch you?
Affinity_Vela_EP05_007: Whether you are exhausted is none of my concern. I am having fun~
Affinity_Vela_EP06_002: I care for them so much that I never light them.
Affinity_Vela_EP06_003: What? That seems like denying a candle's existence. Is that truly right?
Affinity_Vela_EP06_004: You mean I should treasure you?
Affinity_Vela_EP06_005: Hehehe~ You understand me at once. Value me more highly, understood?
Affinity_Vela_EP06_007: That is prejudice, you know. Some people still use them. Hey, are you listening?
Affinity_Vela_EP07_001: I feel my strength gradually returning, little by little.
Affinity_Vela_EP07_003: What is terrible about it?! Aha~ Are you afraid I will regain my power? Hee hee~ The Master is a coward.
Affinity_Vela_EP07_004: It is good if it returns slowly.
Affinity_Vela_EP07_005: Right. Thanks to that, I think I can control my power well too. Hehe~
Affinity_Vela_EP07_007: How could it be bad news? I did not take you for someone so... Never mind. Hmph, I shall say nothing.
Affinity_Vela_EP08_001: The world is fascinating! It is fun! Always fresh and thrilling!
Affinity_Vela_EP08_003: Right, right. But I am curious about other worlds too. Your world, for example? Tell me more about it.
Affinity_Vela_EP08_005: What? What are you imagining? You were the one who sealed me! Ah, that is right. You failed. Hee hee~
Affinity_Vela_EP08_007: Yes. I have seen and heard so many things lately, and it is tremendous fun!
Affinity_Vela_EP09_001: Must those who are given birth always follow their creator?
Affinity_Vela_EP09_002: Why are you suddenly being philosophical?
Affinity_Vela_EP09_003: Suddenly? That is my very essence. Have you never thought about it, Master? Hmph. How boring.
Affinity_Vela_EP09_005: Hmph. Would you listen if you were me? Hey, is that any way to speak to me? Huh?
Affinity_Vela_EP09_007: ...Hmm. Hearing you say it so firmly is somehow a little comforting.
Affinity_Vela_EP10_002: Why are you staring at me like that...?
Affinity_Vela_EP10_003: Forsythia told me not to speak because you were busy. So I merely watched. Am I not behaving well?
Affinity_Vela_EP10_005: They say a guilty conscience needs no accuser. Did you... make some mistake? You did, right?
Affinity_Vela_EP10_007: Wow... What an awful way to speak. Do the others know what a nasty personality you have?
Affinity_Vela_EP11_001: What sort of 'existence' are you in Elias, Master?
Affinity_Vela_EP11_002: I am an existence that performs the role of Master.
Affinity_Vela_EP11_003: That answer is far too obvious to be interesting!
Affinity_Vela_EP11_004: I am an irreplaceable and tremendously important existence!
Affinity_Vela_EP11_005: Ugh, you say something like that about yourself so boldly.
Affinity_Vela_EP11_007: Where did you hear that famous phrase? It is rather good.
Affinity_Vela_EP12_001: The Sprites all live much busier lives than their image suggests. Is that not difficult?
Affinity_Vela_EP12_002: Holding back the urge to play makes playtime even more enjoyable.
Affinity_Vela_EP12_003: Would it not be better to start playing now and keep playing forever?
Affinity_Vela_EP12_004: Astonishingly, some Sprites feel happier when they live busy lives.
Affinity_Vela_EP12_005: Such frightening Sprites exist? Sprites are stranger than ghosts.
Affinity_Vela_EP12_006: You live as a completely idle ghost.
Affinity_Vela_EP12_007: They say this is average for a ghost! Compared with them, I live diligently.
Affinity_Vela_EP13_001: Floating around every day is boring. Will nothing interesting happen at the Order? Perhaps something might explode?
Affinity_Vela_EP13_002: Wait a little. Something is about due to erupt.
Affinity_Vela_EP13_003: Truly? How exciting! I hope it happens soon!
Affinity_Vela_EP13_004: Hmph, not a chance. I protect the Order!
Affinity_Vela_EP13_005: Protect it a little less carefully! Why do you try so hard?!
Affinity_Vela_EP13_006: Make something happen yourself. Become a ghost with initiative.
Affinity_Vela_EP13_007: Then you will scold me! I am not falling for that!
Affinity_Vela_EP14_001: Make me a room at the Order! I want my privacy, or whatever it is called, to be respected~!
Affinity_Vela_EP14_002: I will give you a room, but remove the door.
Affinity_Vela_EP14_004: Would you like my room? I shall sleep in the yard.
Affinity_Vela_EP14_006: Are you already at that age...? I shall put a lock on the door too.
Affinity_Vela_EP14_007: Oh! At last I shall have my own room!
Affinity_Vela_EP15_001: Do you think what I did deserves first place in the Great Elias Commotion Rankings?
Affinity_Vela_EP15_002: Up to this point, I think you rank first.
Affinity_Vela_EP15_003: Only 'up to this point'? You mean someone will overtake me soon? Grr, remaining at the top truly is difficult.
Affinity_Vela_EP15_004: Aiming for first place so halfheartedly is terribly rash.
Affinity_Vela_EP15_005: How many troublemakers can there be if even I cannot take first place?
Affinity_Vela_EP15_006: Honestly, you may struggle even to enter the middle ranks.
Affinity_Vela_EP15_007: Really? Then perhaps I should show this world what a true commotion looks like. You brought this upon yourself, all right?
Affinity_Vela_EP16_001: Hurry! Offer everything to me! This great Existence is hungry!
Affinity_Vela_EP16_002: What shall I give you? A story? Food? Or would you like a film?
Affinity_Vela_EP16_003: H-huh? You will truly give them to me? Give me everything! I choose all of them!
Affinity_Vela_EP16_005: Wh-what? You are simply throwing me out? That is rather cruel...!
Affinity_Vela_EP16_006: I offer myself to you, great Existence!
Affinity_Vela_EP16_007: Hmm... That was not the answer I wanted... but perhaps it is not bad. Fine, I shall accept it this time.
Affinity_Vela_EP17_001: There are many books I want to read, but I keep remembering 'that book,' so I cannot open them easily.
Affinity_Vela_EP17_002: Hee hee, what a coward, running away in terror whenever she sees a book~
Affinity_Vela_EP17_003: Ugh, you are going to tease me like this? I will not play with you anymore, Master!
Affinity_Vela_EP17_004: Let us begin with cute storybooks and gradually cure your fear.
Affinity_Vela_EP17_005: Wow! The Tortoise and the Hare? Is this based on a true story from the Beastfolk Village?
Affinity_Vela_EP17_006: Butter once cried because books frightened her too.
Affinity_Vela_EP17_007: That cute puppy? I am relieved I am not the only one who is afraid.
Affinity_Vela_EP18_001: Am I not a rather fine guest? I cost nothing to feed and occupy very little space.
Affinity_Vela_EP18_002: You would be the perfect guest if you helped with my work sometimes.
Affinity_Vela_EP18_003: Sorry, but I detest troublesome work~
Affinity_Vela_EP18_004: One Sprite costs a fortune to feed, so if at least you do not eat...
Affinity_Vela_EP18_005: I sometimes watch that Sprite friend eat too. It is terrifying. I thought she was the Ghost of Gluttony.
Affinity_Vela_EP18_007: Th-that is cruel. You hurt me...
Affinity_Vela_EP19_001: They say something called 'useless information' exists in the world. Is all information not good?
Affinity_Vela_EP19_002: This conversation is also useless information.
Affinity_Vela_EP19_003: You are very skilled at useless criticism, Master. Now I am upset!
Affinity_Vela_EP19_004: Did you know Beastfolk usually lead with their right foot when they walk?
Affinity_Vela_EP19_006: You eagerly absorb anything you learn. Do not worry too much about it.
Affinity_Vela_EP19_007: Even if I do not want to care, once I know something it is difficult to pretend I do not!
Affinity_Vela_EP20_001: Can you make the most delicious food in the world?
Affinity_Vela_EP20_002: It is the leftovers from breakfast.
Affinity_Vela_EP20_003: I can see straight through your plan to push them onto me!
Affinity_Vela_EP20_004: The most delicious food can only be made from the least delicious ingredients.
Affinity_Vela_EP20_005: You are obviously saying whatever comes to mind to evade the question, but it is not a bad turn of phrase.
Affinity_Vela_EP20_006: I always make it with all my heart, so it is always the most delicious.
Affinity_Vela_EP20_007: That is such a moving line that I feel I ought to burst into tears. Shall I have a good cry?
